name: fxmind
description: Shared project memory for AI agents, plus a prompt refiner, automatic reasoning effort, cache countdown, handoff and agent panel. Ask: "set up fxmind in this project".

judge.title: Judge
judge.description: Haiku (your own Claude login, no key) always judges handoffs and, unless Jev answers, the effort. auto: Jev as well when a TypeSafe key is set. haiku: Haiku only. jev: Jev as well, and its key may also come from ~/.fxmind/jev.env.

typesafeKey.title: TypeSafe API key (optional, only for jev)
typesafeKey.description: For the jev judge. Stored as a secret by Claude Code. Left empty, TYPESAFE_API_KEY is used, and with judge set to jev also ~/.fxmind/jev.env.

handoffSkill.title: Handoff skill (optional)
handoffSkill.description: A skill or slash command that writes the Full handoff, e.g. session-handoff. Empty: fxmind writes it itself (checks git, saves HANDOFF.md). Quick is always a fast fork with the built-in prompt.

handoffAfter.title: After a handoff (first choice)
handoffAfter.description: What the handoff bar starts on; it then remembers your last choice. continue: clear and carry on. confirm: clear, the new chat says where things stand and waits. copy: keep the chat and copy the handoff.

effortBias.title: Effort slider
effortBias.description: -2 cheaper to 2 smarter. Tips the judge's close calls that way; sure calls stay. 0: as the judge says.

effortFloor.title: Never below
effortFloor.description: Auto never picks a lower effort than this.

effortCeiling.title: Never above
effortCeiling.description: Auto never picks a higher effort than this.

hide.title: Switched off
hide.description: Comma-separated: handoff (the footer button), timer (the cache countdown), reason (the judge's line), swamp (the context alert), hot (the running-low alert), cold (the cold-cache alert). Empty shows everything. The judge's line is off unless switched on.

modelAuto.title: Cheaper model when it can (experimental)
modelAuto.description: on: a prompt the judge calls simple may run on a cheaper model (Haiku 5.5 or Sonnet), never above the chat's own, when the switch pays. It rarely does in a chat that is in use: the other model rereads the whole chat. off (default): every prompt runs on the chat's model.

helpers.title: Effort for helpers
helpers.description: on: every subagent (helper) the chat sends off gets an effort picked by the judge before it starts, so a quick search runs at low instead of the chat's effort. off (default): helpers run at the chat's effort.

handoffButton.title: Handoff button
handoffButton.description: advised: the button is Compact, and turns into a glowing Handoff when Haiku says a fresh chat would pay off. always: the button is always Handoff.

compactWith.title: Compact with
compactWith.description: haiku: Haiku 5.5 writes the summary when the chat is compacted (far cheaper). session: the chat's own model, as Claude Code does it.

swampAt.title: Swamped at
swampAt.description: The swamp band shows once the context fills this percent of the window.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: auto: light panels when Claude Code's theme is light, dark otherwise. dark and light fix it.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The accent colour of everything the effort bar draws. mint: fxmind's own, the site's green on its dark ink. violet, orange (Claude Code orange) and rose (cherry-blossom pink, with falling petals).

layout.title: Look
layout.description: default: a dashboard band above the prompt (effort, Auto, cache, context, handoff). minimal: small buttons in the footer, no band.

refine.title: Prompt refiner
refine.description: auto: a demand to build something is held back, its doubts asked above the prompt, and a prompt written from the answers is sent in its place. command: only with /fxmind-refine <demand>. off: never.

refineWith.title: Refine with
refineWith.description: The model that reads the demand and writes the refined prompt. haiku: Haiku 5.5 (fast, cheap). sonnet: Sonnet 5.5. opus: Opus 5.5 (smartest, slower). session: the chat's own model.

refineClear.title: Clear the chat before the refined prompt
refineClear.description: on: the chat is cleared and the refined prompt starts a fresh one (it carries over what the old chat decided). off: the chat is kept.

refineSend.title: Refined prompt
refineSend.description: send: the refined prompt is sent at once. fill: it is put in the prompt box to read and edit first.

gateV.title: Gate V review
gateV.description: ask: when a task reaches Gate V, the band above the prompt asks whether to run the independent review and with which agent (or skip it). auto: the review runs at once, as before.

coldPrompt.title: Prompt in a cold chat
coldPrompt.description: What happens to a message typed once the prompt cache went cold on a big chat. off: it is sent (the chat is reread at full price). block: it is held back and stays in the prompt box; sending it again sends it as is. compact: the chat is compacted first, then the message is sent by itself.

projectSetup.title: Repository without fxmind
projectSetup.description: In a git repository with no .fxmind yet. ask: a band above the prompt offers the install (the fxmind-setup skill, then /fxmind init). auto: the agent is asked to install it at once, once per repository. off: nothing.

coldAt.title: Cold from
coldAt.description: From how many thousand tokens of context a cold cache counts: the cold band shows and the prompt-in-a-cold-chat setting acts.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the effort bar, its settings and alerts. en: English. pt-BR: Portuguese (Brazil).
